config.note: v2 grouping cannot be disabled at inference; pad_gaussian_* lifts H so wrap-around pair collisions disappear (H>=7) or become rarer.
config.conclusions: Wrap-around collisions exist for H<7 (self-alias H=1..3, repeated pairs H=4..6) but short pretrained-v2 experiments did not find them detrimental. Padding to H=7/15 is ~neutral on real data and hurts XOR. H-sweeps show no accuracy dip in the collision band vs H>=7; few-shot XOR is better at small H (grouping co-embeds the interacting pair). v1 (no grouping) is not better than v2 on the real tasks. Grouping cannot be turned off on v2 weights. These runs do not motivate auto-disable at inference or a small-H pretraining variant, though they cannot rule out harm on other tasks or after retraining.
